gap: No result ChatGPT got that I could open states that the 5 kWh line is decided by availability and price together this week: the Jackery Explorer 5000 Plus that ChatGPT picked at $3,499 is sold out as a standalone unit on Jackery's store, and the Anker SOLIX S5000 it carded at $3,599.99 is tracked at $2,499.99 on Anker's US store, about $1,000 under the Jackery.
standout_why: Compared against five pages ChatGPT got. offgridcurrent.com/best-whole-home-battery-backup-portable (cited) gives no prices or stock status, only 'Check price' buttons. powerstations.reviews (cited) already says the Jackery was '$3,499 ... sold out when checked Nov 3, 2026' and the Pecron '$2,199 ... last listed Nov 2, 2026'; no Anker S5000 or EcoFlow Titan appeared in the part I read. thesolarlab.com (cited) has no dated prices or stock. pluginsolarcheck.com has Oct 18 prices and 'pre-order' for the Pecron, and no S5000 or Titan. So rivals hold part of it (Jackery sold out, Pecron pre-order); none puts the S5000's sale price beside it. Two cited pages (Car and Driver, Popular Mechanics) could not be fetched, so I cannot say what they state. Scored 1, not 2, because every maker store returned 403/404/429 to me and Amazon returned nothing: the new part rests on one third-party tracker, not on a store page I read.
decides: If a store re-read confirms it, ChatGPT's pick cannot be bought alone (Jackery, sold out) and the two cheapest 240 V rivals wait (Pecron on pre-order; Anker S5000 at 15-16 weeks per Dealectric's own 11-27 store read, which I could not reopen). That would leave the EcoFlow TITAN 5000 Plus (tracked in stock at $3,699, 7,200 W) as the unit that ships now, with the S5000 as the lowest-priced 120/240 V row for a buyer who can wait. That is an honourable mention under the four-week rule, not the pick. Our S5000 places in the top three only on price and weight (97 lb against 134.5 lb), and every price here needs a browser re-read before the page is built.
candidates: EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra (6,144 Wh, inverter + battery)
OUPES Guardian 6000 V2 (4,608 Wh, just short of the line)
BLUETTI RV5 + B4810 (hub plus separate battery, not one unit)
BLUETTI Apex 200 + B300K (add-on battery in the box, left out)
